rule_text:
Trigger: When citing a specific number or detail from a source in a literature-based proposal,
Action: attach it to its evidence ID and verify the text falls inside the excerpt actually read; if it is only in an abstract, search summary, or outside the recorded read range, read it directly or label it unverified and keep it out of load-bearing claims.
Boundary: Covers factual/citation claims, not explicitly labeled hypotheses; absence from the read trace means unsupported here, not false.
Evidence: review:EVIDENCE_AUDIT
